text:
Upon the white pillow,

beyond desire,

upon the white night,

upon the white silence,

upon ourselves,

the souls in their meeting.


Upon my raised forehead,

the exact moment,

you say that in a shadow

you live in my memory.


Synthesis of the hours.

You and I in motion,

fighting life to life,

delighting body to body.


You say that in these shadows

you live in my memory,

and they are the same shadows

that are living inside me.

translation.title: Memory of Shadows
translation.editorial_note: The translation treats the source's likely typo as 'Synthesis' and keeps the poem's white silence and living shadows.
